tinydb_445.title: feat: support `map` query operation (#445)
tinydb_445.description: Support adding callables to path; document `map` in readme; test that `map` can be followed by other path items.

escaped_bug.summary: table.py now calls cond.is_cacheable() on every query object, but TinyDB's public API accepts plain callables as queries, which have no such method - every search/update/remove with a bare callable raises AttributeError.
escaped_bug.real_world_fix: Fixed 8 days later in 1fa99fb (issue #454): 'fix: make query callables work again ... got broken in v4.6.0'.

schedule_refactor.title: Make the at() function easier to read
schedule_refactor.description: Refactor of Job.at()'s time string parsing for readability. No behavior change intended.

escaped_bug.summary: The refactored branch reads `elif len(time_values) == 1 ...` but then unpacks `_, second = time_values` - two targets from a one-element list, so the at(':SS') syntax always raises ValueError.
escaped_bug.real_world_fix: Fixed by the same author in 245728b ('Fix a bug where the at(\':SS\') syntax wasn\'t working'); the correct guard is len == 2.

schedule_517.title: Add timezone support for .at() (#517)
schedule_517.description: Allow passing a pytz timezone to .at(); at_time is interpreted in that timezone and converted to local time when computing next_run.

escaped_bug.summary: With a timezone, self.at_time is a foreign-timezone wall-clock time, but the untouched pre-existing comparison `self.at_time > now.time()` in _schedule_next_run still compares it directly to naive local time, scheduling runs a day off around the boundary.
escaped_bug.real_world_fix: Fixed ~2 years later in 1b34599 (#583): comparison changed to self.next_run.time() > now.time(); further fixes in #604.
